title: faraway — flyway

sentences.sentence: She dreamed of flying away to exotic faraway places.
sentences.translation: 她梦想着飞到遥远的异国。

sentences.sentence: faraway noises
sentences.translation: 远处的喧嚣声

sentences.sentence: His usual ploy is to pretend he’s ill.
sentences.translation: 他惯用的花招是装病。

sentences.sentence: It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
sentences.translation: 在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。

sentences.sentence: With a third group, she activated the squeak as if by accident.
sentences.translation: 对于第三组，她则假装吱吱声是偶然发生的。

sentences.sentence: With a third group, she activated the squeak as if by accident.
sentences.translation: 对于第三组孩子，她展示发出吱吱声好像意外发出一样。

sentences.sentence: She interrupted herself after demonstrating the squeak by saying she had to go and write something down, thus suggesting that she might not have finished the demonstration.
sentences.translation: 当演示完吱吱声后，她停了下来，说自己有事得走了，并在纸上写下了些东西，以此暗示也许她还没完成整个过程。

sentences.sentence: He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
sentences.translation: 他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。

sentences.sentence: Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
sentences.translation: 葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

sentences.sentence: The family never quite regained its former influence.
sentences.translation: 这个家族再也没有恢复往昔的影响力。

sentences.sentence: He somehow managed to regain his balance .
sentences.translation: 他总算恢复了平衡。

sentences.sentence: Government forces have regained control of the city.
sentences.translation: 政府军已重新控制了这座城市。

sentences.sentence: When she regained consciousness (= woke up after being unconscious ) , she was lying on the floor.
sentences.translation: 她恢复知觉醒来时，正躺在地板上。

sentences.sentence: He looked stunned, but he soon regain ed his composure (= became calm again ) .
sentences.translation: 他似乎愣了愣，但很快就恢复平静了。

sentences.sentence: The doctors don’t know if he will ever regain the use of his legs.
sentences.translation: 医生们不知道他的腿是否还能恢复功能。

sentences.sentence: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
sentences.translation: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

translations.translation: 英雄品质, 英雄主义

sentences.sentence: ...individual acts of heroism.
sentences.translation: …个人英雄主义行为。

translations.translation: 难以觉察地, 不显著地

sentences.sentence: He received a six-month suspension for unprofessional behaviour.
sentences.translation: 他因有违职业道德的行为被停职六个月。

sentences.sentence: Trade discounts may be used as a competitive stratagem to secure customer loyalty.
sentences.translation: 商业折扣可以用作保持顾客忠诚度的一种竞争策略。

phrases.translation: 计较（尤指忿恨不满）；郁闷地沉思

sentences.sentence: Don’t sit at home brooding all day.
sentences.translation: 别整天坐在家里闷闷不乐的。

sentences.sentence: And because of the oxytocin and vasopressin, they want to have sex with the same vole.
sentences.translation: 又因为催产素和垂体后叶加压素的作用，它们只想与同一田鼠做爱。

sentences.sentence: A fledgling white-tailed kite [bottom] grabs a vole from its father 100 feet above the ground in mid-flight.
sentences.translation: 一只年幼的白尾鸢（下面那只）在离地面100英尺的高度的飞行中从父亲爪上攫取野鼠。

sentences.sentence: He could mimic all the teachers’ accents.
sentences.translation: 他能模仿所有老师的口音。

sentences.sentence: ‘I’m so sorry,’ she mimicked.
sentences.translation: “很抱歉。”她学着说道。

translations.translation: 难处理的, 难控制的

sentences.sentence: People were visiting the house every day, sometimes in unmanageable numbers.
sentences.translation: 每天都有人来参观这座房子，有时人数多得难以管理。

phrases.translation: 制铆钉机；铆钉机；拉钉机

sentences.translation: 一个腿上多毛的干瘦男人

sentences.sentence: a hairy caterpillar
sentences.translation: 毛茸茸的毛虫

sentences.sentence: It’s an ideal location for a wedding reception .
sentences.translation: 这里是举办喜宴的理想地点。

sentences.sentence: The occasion was marked by a civic reception .
sentences.translation: 市里举行招待会庆祝这个特别的时刻。

sentences.sentence: Yet the physical changes that go with affluence destroy the habitats of migratory shorebirds and seabirds, wreaking havoc on their numbers along the crucial East Asian-Australasian flyway.
sentences.translation: 然而开发所带来的自然地理变化破坏了迁徙滨鸟和海鸟的栖息地，也就给重要的东亚-大洋洲候鸟迁徙路线沿途上的这些鸟类带来了灾难性的破坏，导致它们数量的剧减。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 386 单元

faraway
音标：英 /'fɑːrəweɪ; fɑːrə'weɪ/  美 /'fɑrəwe/
adj. 遥远的
例句：She dreamed of flying away to exotic faraway places.
她梦想着飞到遥远的异国。
例句：faraway noises
远处的喧嚣声

ploy
音标：英 /plɒɪ/  美 /plɔɪ/
n. 花招，手段
例句：His usual ploy is to pretend he’s ill.
他惯用的花招是装病。

noisily
adv. 吵闹地
例句：It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。

squeak
音标：英 /skwiːk/  美 /skwik/
n. 吱吱声
v. 吱吱叫
例句：With a third group, she activated the squeak as if by accident.
对于第三组，她则假装吱吱声是偶然发生的。
例句：With a third group, she activated the squeak as if by accident.
对于第三组孩子，她展示发出吱吱声好像意外发出一样。
例句：She interrupted herself after demonstrating the squeak by saying she had to go and write something down, thus suggesting that she might not have finished the demonstration.
当演示完吱吱声后，她停了下来，说自己有事得走了，并在纸上写下了些东西，以此暗示也许她还没完成整个过程。

crouch
音标：英 /kraʊtʃ/  美 /kraʊtʃ/
v. 蜷缩, 蹲伏
例句：He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。
例句：Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

regain
音标：英 /rɪ'geɪn/  美 /rɪ'ɡen/
v. 收回；恢复
短语：moisture regain — 吸湿（性）；回潮率；回潮
短语：regain consciousness — 苏醒；恢复知觉
例句：The family never quite regained its former influence.
这个家族再也没有恢复往昔的影响力。
例句：He somehow managed to regain his balance .
他总算恢复了平衡。
例句：Government forces have regained control of the city.
政府军已重新控制了这座城市。
例句：When she regained consciousness (= woke up after being unconscious ) , she was lying on the floor.
她恢复知觉醒来时，正躺在地板上。
例句：He looked stunned, but he soon regain ed his composure (= became calm again ) .
他似乎愣了愣，但很快就恢复平静了。
例句：The doctors don’t know if he will ever regain the use of his legs.
医生们不知道他的腿是否还能恢复功能。

outcome
音标：英 /'aʊtkʌm/  美 /'aʊt'kʌm/
n. 结果, 成果
短语：possible outcome — 可能结果
短语：therapeutic outcome — 治疗结果
短语：learning outcome — 学习结果；学习成果
例句：People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

heroism
音标：英 /'herəʊɪz(ə)m/  美 /'hɛroɪzəm/
n. 英雄品质, 英雄主义
例句：...individual acts of heroism.
…个人英雄主义行为。

inconspicuously
adv. 难以觉察地, 不显著地

matron
音标：英 /'meɪtr(ə)n/  美 /'metrən/
n. 主妇；护士长

suspension
音标：英 /sə'spenʃ(ə)n/  美 /sə'spɛnʃən/
n. 暂停, 中止
短语：suspension bridge — 吊桥
短语：suspension system — 悬架系统；悬挂装置；悬浮体系；悬置系统
短语：in suspension — 悬浮中
短语：magnetic suspension — 磁悬浮，悬磁性
短语：active suspension — 主动制导悬架系统（一种由计算机控制的机动车悬架系统）
短语：cell suspension — 细胞悬液
短语：air suspension — 空气弹簧；空气悬挂
短语：suspension culture — 悬浮培养；悬液培养
短语：front suspension — 前悬架；前悬挂；前悬吊
短语：rear suspension — 后悬吊，后悬吊系统；后悬挂装置
短语：independent suspension — 独立悬架，独立悬挂
短语：active suspension system — 主动式悬吊系统；主动减震系统
短语：suspension cable — 悬缆；吊索
短语：aqueous suspension — 水性悬液；水中悬浮体
短语：suspension arm — 吊臂；弹簧吊架；悬挂臂，悬架臂
短语：spring suspension — 弹簧悬置
短语：suspension bearing — 吊轴承
短语：temporary suspension — 暂停
短语：pulp suspension — 浆料悬浮液
短语：suspension spring — 悬簧；托簧；悬挂弹簧
例句：He received a six-month suspension for unprofessional behaviour.
他因有违职业道德的行为被停职六个月。

stratagem
音标：英 /'strætədʒəm/  美 /'strætədʒəm/
n. 战略, 计谋
例句：Trade discounts may be used as a competitive stratagem to secure customer loyalty.
商业折扣可以用作保持顾客忠诚度的一种竞争策略。

brood
音标：英 /bruːd/  美 /brud/
v. 沉思；孵蛋 n一窝
短语：brood over — 计较（尤指忿恨不满）；郁闷地沉思
短语：brood on — 念念不忘， 计较（特指忿恨不满）
短语：brood pouch — 育仔囊；育儿袋
例句：Don’t sit at home brooding all day.
别整天坐在家里闷闷不乐的。

vole
音标：英 /vəʊl/  美 /vol/
n. 田鼠
例句：And because of the oxytocin and vasopressin, they want to have sex with the same vole.
又因为催产素和垂体后叶加压素的作用，它们只想与同一田鼠做爱。
例句：A fledgling white-tailed kite [bottom] grabs a vole from its father 100 feet above the ground in mid-flight.
一只年幼的白尾鸢（下面那只）在离地面100英尺的高度的飞行中从父亲爪上攫取野鼠。

mimic
音标：英 /'mɪmɪk/  美 /'mɪmɪk/
v. 模仿, 模拟
短语：mimic warfare — 模拟战争
例句：He could mimic all the teachers’ accents.
他能模仿所有老师的口音。
例句：‘I’m so sorry,’ she mimicked.
“很抱歉。”她学着说道。

unmanageable
音标：英 /ʌn'mænɪdʒəb(ə)l/  美 /ʌn'mænɪdʒəbl/
adj. 难处理的, 难控制的
例句：People were visiting the house every day, sometimes in unmanageable numbers.
每天都有人来参观这座房子，有时人数多得难以管理。

rivet
音标：英 /'rɪvɪt/  美 /'rɪvɪt/
n. 铆钉  v固定
短语：blind rivet — 盲孔铆钉；空心铆钉
短语：rivet machine — 制铆钉机；铆钉机；拉钉机
短语：rivet joint — 铆钉接合

hairy
音标：英 /'heərɪ/  美 /'hɛri/
adj. 毛发的，多毛的
短语：hairy root — 毛状根，发根
短语：hairy crab — 大闸蟹，毛蟹
短语：hairy cell leukemia — 毛细胞白血病
例句：a skinny guy with hairy legs
一个腿上多毛的干瘦男人
例句：a hairy caterpillar
毛茸茸的毛虫

reception
音标：英 /rɪ'sepʃ(ə)n/  美 /rɪ'sɛpʃən/
n. 招待会；接受
短语：warm reception — 热情接待
短语：reception desk — 接待处（等于front desk）
短语：reception area — 接待处；接待室
短语：reception room — 会客室，接待室
短语：wedding reception — 结婚宴会，婚宴
短语：reception centre — n. 接待处
例句：It’s an ideal location for a wedding reception .
这里是举办喜宴的理想地点。
例句：The occasion was marked by a civic reception .
市里举行招待会庆祝这个特别的时刻。

flyway
音标：英 /'flaɪweɪ/  美 /'flaɪ,we/
n. 候鸟迁徙所经的路径
例句：Yet the physical changes that go with affluence destroy the habitats of migratory shorebirds and seabirds, wreaking havoc on their numbers along the crucial East Asian-Australasian flyway.
然而开发所带来的自然地理变化破坏了迁徙滨鸟和海鸟的栖息地，也就给重要的东亚-大洋洲候鸟迁徙路线沿途上的这些鸟类带来了灾难性的破坏，导致它们数量的剧减。
